order: write-ahead: session_start and the decision are written before the file moves; session_end after
id_rule: skillId(id) === id: lower-case letters, digits and dashes, at most 60
evidence_vouching: a skill_trial record naming the report's sha256, alone in a sealed trail (session_start mode trial, skill_trial, session_end) whose chain verifies, agreeing with the report on skill, content_sha256, both surface hashes and meets_thresholds; with [audit.attest] declared, covered by verified signed heads

require_trial.verifier_pinned_by_surface: public_key required, inline or under .gnomon/ (not skills/proposed, extensions); a verify command alone is refused; evidence is checked against the key only

agent_session_checks: marker in this environment, any value (empty included)
marker in an ancestor's environment (/proc/<pid>/environ, Linux)
a gnomon process among the ancestors (/proc/<pid>/cmdline, Linux), other than a launcher of the same decision
person_required: stdin and stdout a terminal (authorised_by tty); otherwise [audit.attest] person_present = true and the signer signs the head covering the decision before it is applied (authorised_by person_present_signer); otherwise refused, exit 3, nothing written
